name: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman)
description: PM POSHAN is a centrally sponsored scheme that provides one hot cooked nutritious meal per school day to children studying in government and government-aided primary and upper primary classes.
benefits: Provides hot cooked meals providing 450 calories and 12g protein for primary classes (I-V), and 700 calories and 20g protein for upper primary classes (VI-VIII). Aims to improve the nutritional status of children, encourage school attendance, and promote social equity.
eligibility: All students enrolled in government, local body, and government-aided primary and upper primary schools, as well as Special Training Centers (STCs) across India.
documents: School enrollment record. No separate individual documentation or paperwork is required by students or parents.
application_process: Automatic entitlement upon enrollment and attendance in any participating government or government-aided school. No application process needed.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Primary and upper primary school students (Classes I-VIII)
